adopted by ययाति after पूरु's coronation; living on fruits and roots and always in peace, having conquered his mind and anger, was engaged for 1,००० years in offering oblations to पितृस् and Devas and in fire rites and entertaining guests; performed penance feeding on water alone for 3 years, on air for a year, in the midst of fire for another year and standing on one leg for six months; reached heaven.
